entry.name: DexSkills
entry.title: DexSkills: Skill Segmentation Using Haptic Data for Learning Autonomous Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Tasks
entry.summary: Allegro hand on a UR5 arm with a custom magnetic tactile sensor on each of its 4 fingertips, teleoperated through Virtuose 6D and HGlove leader devices; released as preprocessed haptic feature tensors for 20 primitive skills and 20 long-horizon tasks with a sponge, a carton and a bottle, with no camera stream.
entry.hand: Allegro Hand (16 DoF) on a UR5 arm

sensor.note: One custom magnetic sensor per fingertip (paper cites the authors' earlier sensor design). The paper's features per fingertip are the norm of (Fx, Fy, Fz) and a binary contact flag; the release keys state_input (raw haptic data) and feature_input (features) inside .pt batches. Files not opened.
sensor.maker: custom (cited as the authors' earlier work)

scale.text: 20 primitive skills (10 demonstrations each for most, 20 for Touch, Wipe Back and Grasp) and 20 long-horizon tasks; 3 objects (sponge, tomato-passata carton, liquid bottle); 71 shuffled training batch files plus 20 long-horizon files

entry.access: In the GitHub repository ARQ-CRISP/DexSkills under DexSkill_dataset/: dataset/ (71 shuffled training .pt files, 96 MB), LH_dataset/ (20 long-horizon .pt files, 42 MB), json_file/LH_final.json (human segmentation labels) and trained_policy/ (18 checkpoints, 180 MB); no login.
caveats: Preprocessed features only: the training files are shuffled batches of 256 samples, so individual demonstrations cannot be recovered from them; only the 20 long-horizon files keep time order.
No video, depth or object pose; haptic data means fingertip touch plus arm and hand proprioception.
Touch is 4 fingertip sensors, summarised in the paper as force norm and contact per fingertip.
PyTorch .pt pickles; load them with weights_only or in a sandbox.
The page in the repository says 60 training files; the repository holds 71 (data_0.pt to data_70.pt, the last two smaller).
No LICENSE file in the repository.

tracking.system: Allegro Hand joint states and fingertip positions; UR5 end-effector pose and velocity
tracking.note: 16 hand joints, fingertip position and velocity (3 each per finger), end-effector pose and velocity (6 each)
teleoperation with haptic feedback from the follower robot

unconfirmed: tasks = 40: 20 primitive skills plus 20 long-horizon tasks (A-T), as the paper lists them.
scenes = 1: one lab setup is described; not stated as a count.
Per-skill demonstration counts are from the paper text; the total was not counted from the files.
The arXiv record has no venue; OpenAlex dates the work 2024-10-14, which may be a conference version not checked.

license.name: not stated
license.quote: no LICENSE file in the repository

download.format: PyTorch .pt files with keys state_input, feature_input, state_output, features_output, label (training batches); one unshuffled .pt per long-horizon task plus LH_final.json
download.total_size: 318 MB (dataset 96 MB, LH_dataset 42 MB, trained_policy 180 MB)

channels.note: raw haptic data (fingertip touch and proprioception) per the repository page; files not opened

channels.name: feature_input
channels.note: the paper's features: fingertip force norm and contact, end-effector pose and velocity, hand joint and fingertip states; files not opened

channels.name: label
channels.note: skill name per sample; from the repository page
